# Signet Artists

> Live music for private events across Colorado. Two bands and a DJ, two players to thirteen, one contract. The invoice is one page and it adds up to the number we published.

Signet Artists is a live music company for private events in Denver, the Front Range, and the mountain corridor. Rates are published rather than quoted on request; the full card is on the pricing page.

## Pages

- [Blog](https://signetartists.com/blog/): Occasional writing on live music for private events: planning it, pricing it, and the music itself. From Signet Artists in Denver.
- [Check a Date](https://signetartists.com/contact/): Tell us the date, the room and the guest count. Availability and an exact number back inside 24 to 48 hours, in business hours.
- [Corporate & Galas](https://signetartists.com/corporate/): Corporate parties and galas in Denver and the mountain corridor. Transitions rehearsed against the run of show, COI and W-9 with the contract, net-30 on approval, every rate published.
- [Signet Artists — Live music for private events in Denver, Colorado](https://signetartists.com/): Live music for private events across Colorado. Two bands and a DJ, two players to thirteen, one contract, and every rate published before you write to us.
- [The Music](https://signetartists.com/music/): The Standards for ceremony, cocktails and dinner. The Headliners for the dance floor. A DJ to carry the late end. Two players to thirteen, one contract.
- [For Planners](https://signetartists.com/planners/): How we work with planners: a named contact before the night, paperwork that arrives with the contract, published pricing you can forward unedited, and unbundling treated as normal.
- [Pricing](https://signetartists.com/pricing/): Published rates for live music at private events in Denver and the Colorado mountain corridor. Call-out plus hourly, production included, and hour five costs what hour four cost.

## Blog

- [What live music costs for a corporate event](https://signetartists.com/blog/what-live-music-costs-corporate-event/): How a live band's price for a corporate event is built: call-out plus hourly, worked totals from duo to thirteen-piece, and what travel and holiday dates add.
- [What a band needs from the room](https://signetartists.com/blog/what-a-band-needs-from-the-room/): Stage size, electrical circuits, load-in and insurance paperwork for a live band at a corporate event, with published stage dimensions compared against a working band's rider.
- [Playing around a program](https://signetartists.com/blog/playing-around-a-program/): How a live band works around a corporate program: remarks, award walk-ons, auctions, video packages and the volume shift, with who cues each moment.

## Rates

- Duo: $600 call-out + $450/hour. Four hours = $2,400.
- Trio: $1,000 call-out + $600/hour. Four hours = $3,400.
- Quartet: $1,600 call-out + $800/hour. Four hours = $4,800.
- Quintet: $2,200 call-out + $1,000/hour. Four hours = $6,200.
- Seven-piece: $3,500 call-out + $1,250/hour. Four hours = $8,500.
- Ten-piece: $5,300 call-out + $1,800/hour. Four hours = $12,500.
- Thirteen-piece: $8,000 call-out + $2,500/hour. Four hours = $18,000.
- DJ: $800 call-out + $350/hour. Four hours = $2,200.

Price = call-out + (hours x hourly rate). There is no overtime rate. Adding a smaller group to an existing booking bills at the hourly rate only, with no second call-out.
